sigma.title: Intelligence for CX decisions
sigma.body: Sigma is a complete customer experience management platform that integrates channels, automates interactions and generates real-time insights.
sigma.strong: Every Sigma module works in an integrated way to deliver a continuous, intelligent, customer-centric journey.

dialogi.title: Connecting brands and people
dialogi.body: Dialogi is an artificial intelligence platform built to create more human, fluid and efficient digital conversations.
dialogi.strong: Bringing together WhatsApp, chat, social media and voice, Dialogi connects brands and customers with speed, empathy and intelligent automation.

platform.title: Intelligence for
platform.body: Sigma is a complete customer experience management platform: it integrates channels, automates interactions and generates real-time insights.
platform.strong: Every module works in an integrated way to deliver a continuous, intelligent, results-driven journey.
platform.brain: Autonomous AI agents that understand intent and carry fluid conversations, in voice and text.
platform.channel: Every touchpoint brought together in a continuous, secure and intelligent journey.
platform.insights: Interactions become metrics, patterns and next steps for the operation.

trust.body: of customers say that **trust in a brand** is a deciding factor in their purchase.

security.title: Sensitive data.
security.body1: Every conversation, information exchange and customer record carries sensitive data that must be handled securely.
security.body2: SigmaCX was designed with security protocols, end-to-end encryption and compliance with global standards. From the moment a customer sends a message until the service is completed, everything stays protected and monitored.
